packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-core
packages.summary: Code-first decorators for data model definition. The CLI reads this metadata to generate Data API Builder configuration.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-data
packages.summary: DAB-compliant data client for GraphQL access patterns against the generated DAB endpoint.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-auth
packages.summary: Authentication helpers: magic-link sign-in, token management, sign-in flows for Rayfin Builder apps.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-client
packages.summary: High-level Rayfin client entrypoint composing auth and data APIs behind a single configured client.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-lib
packages.summary: Shared HTTP and client utilities used by higher-level Rayfin SDKs.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-functions
packages.summary: Client-side surface for invoking Rayfin user data functions from app code. Provides `FunctionClient` and `FunctionsSchema` behind `client.functions`. Authoring handlers is the separate `@microsoft/fabric-user-data-functions` package.

packages.name: @microsoft/fabric-user-data-functions
packages.summary: Authoring surface and Azure Functions worker extension for Microsoft Fabric User Data Functions. Provides `udf.func()` registration, `RayfinContext` (data client, tokens, secrets), `AudienceType` connections, and the typegen that emits `types.ts`. Scaffolded by `rayfin functions init`; import `RayfinContext` from here, not from `@microsoft/rayfin-functions`.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-storage
packages.summary: Experimental — type-safe blob storage client for Rayfin storage backends. Requires the `@blob()` decorator from `@microsoft/rayfin-core/experimental`.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-auth-provider-fabric
packages.summary: Microsoft Fabric token provider for Rayfin auth flows.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-app-state-fabric
packages.summary: Deep-link application state for Rayfin apps embedded in the Microsoft Fabric portal. Reads launch state and writes shareable, bookmarkable portal URLs.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-connectors
packages.summary: Typed runtime for invoking Rayfin function-bridge connectors. Mounted as `client.connectors` by `ConnectorsRayfinClient`.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-connector-fabric-semanticmodel
packages.summary: Fabric semantic model (Power BI dataset) connector. Runs DAX through `executeQuery`, with an optional `resultSetRowCountLimit` row guard.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-connector-kusto
packages.summary: Experimental — typed connector marker and query-result normalization for Fabric KQL Database connectors.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-connector-fabric-graphql
packages.summary: Category A GraphQL-backed connector types. Provides the `GraphQLBackedConnector` entity marker and CRUD operation gating for the typed connectors surface.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-cli
packages.summary: Rayfin command-line interface: scaffolding, configuration, deployment, and the `rayfin docs` command group for offline-friendly agent grounding.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-local-dev
packages.summary: Local-development adapters for Rayfin applications, including same-origin Vite routing to the Functions host selected by `rayfin dev`.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-mcp
packages.summary: Model Context Protocol server exposing Rayfin docs as `list_docs`, `search_docs`, `get_doc`, and `discover_packages` tools.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-docs
packages.summary: Docs indexing/discovery library powering the CLI and MCP server. Handles the `rayfinDocs` per-package convention and merges installed package docs.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-guide
packages.summary: Cross-cutting Builder guides — getting started, auth overview, data permissions, CLI commands. Discovered via the `rayfinDocs` field.

packages.name: @microsoft/rayfin-host-docs
packages.summary: Host service reference docs for Rayfin .NET hosting components (WebService, Auth, DataApi, Function). Discovered via the rayfinDocs field.

packages.name: @microsoft/create-rayfin
packages.summary: App scaffolding tool for bootstrapping new Rayfin projects via `npm create rayfin@latest`.
